git diff ca682281..5e036ba0 and git show f2e52393 for the instruction notes
evidence: Frozen instruction.md and all six notes hash-match the manifest (instruction.md a31f3827..., overview fa96037d..., policy eda7b934..., security 7787c66f..., integration ef7adb80..., behaviour 3b87d89f..., ui 31139d91...) and are byte-identical to projects/colderwater-playground-devtools at HEAD 5e036ba0. instruction.md is three first-person paragraphs ('I'd like a small local playground...', 'I often paste a long one-line experiment...', 'please check it yourself the way I'll use it') with no list, table, framework or file-layout recipe; '/app', 'node /app/server.js' and '/app/app.db' are the template runtime contract that row 4 requires. Whole-task sweep for the flagged pattern (notes reading as an acceptance checklist): no bullet or numbered lines in any of the seven files (regex ^\s*([-*]|[0-9]+\.)\s returns nothing); 'must|shall|required|requirement|contract|acceptance|criteria|the following' returns exactly one hit, behaviour.md:13 'Restoring from an old page must not overwrite a newer save', an ordinary sentence. Each note is motivated first-person prose ('I keep the browser's network panel open while I debug, so please make restores ordinary HTTP requests', 'My connection drops now and then, so...', 'I run code I've pasted from all over the place, so...', 'I sometimes check things on my phone, so at about 390 px wide...'). Commit 5e036ba0 rewrote the last spec-voice lines in overview.md:5, policy.md:3,5 ('Use the public behaviour in these notes as the contract' is gone), security.md:3,5 ('must not be able to reach my server', 'Refuse dynamic evaluation ... with clear feedback') and integration.md:5,7 in the requester's voice. Nothing got looser: each rewrite keeps the same requirement (no install/build step; library shared across contexts; long line editable; own editing surface, still explicitly bounded by ui.md:3 and gated by gates/constraints/judge.toml; preview cannot read the page, library or storage, and a fetch to localhost or 127.0.0.1 must fail; refuse eval/Function/WebAssembly/workers/dynamic import with clear feedback; keywords inside strings and comments are harmless). 'grey out Undo and Redo' (ui.md:9) matches polish/judge.toml:50, which grades a visible unavailable state. Since f2e52393, ui.md gained Ctrl+A and backward Find wrap, which add requirements. behaviour.md:13 dropped 'saves' from the HTTP-transport sentence, which removes an ungraded demand and does not loosen any criterion. The notes still use 'six notes', and six files exist. Counterexample attempt: could a reviewer read ui.md as a checklist? It is dense, a power user's account of how they work, and several clauses are test-shaped with no stated motive: ui.md:7 'if my selection ends at the very start of the next line, leave that next line alone', ui.md:11 'Replace current should never land on text it has just put in' and 'Redo has nothing left to redo'. Each one is still phrased as an experience in a paragraph, with no list structure. integration.md:3,11 (port/0.0.0.0, symlink rule) stay impersonal and technical. They mirror the template's own impersonal integration.md runtime contract, so they are not a defect. These are residual reviewer-variance hot spots (P3 at most), not a credible failure of row 1. This verdict covers source wording only. It does not predict the hosted portal QC result.
